title: New Initiatives Aligned With The National Agenda
definition: Policy-driven S&T interventions synchronized with India's overarching developmental goals, including Atmanirbhar Bharat, Digital India, Net-Zero targets, and Viksit Bharat 2047.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for GS Paper III (Science & Technology - Policy, Indigenous Technologies, and Policy Organization of S&T) and Essay papers focused on technology-led governance and national development.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of New Initiatives Aligned With The National Agenda.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core Science and Technology policy frameworks
Basic understanding of national missions and institutional setups like TDB, DST, and DSIR
